title: Benchmark Mineral Intelligence | AI Connector
author: @benchmarkmin
text: Benchmark AI ConnectorNew MCP technology puts our world-leading energy market data inside your existing tools: Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and more.Set up your team's connection in minutes.Request Access Instant insights from a source you can trust. AI-assisted analysis no longer means sacrificing data integrity.The breadth of data included in a Benchmark subscription - from prices and costs to the forward-looking balance - can now be generated in seconds within the tools your team is already using.Same world-class data quality, new standards of accessibility.Benchmark's AI Connector is built on the same open Model Context Protocol (MCP) technology used for industry-standard integrations.How the AI Connector Works Powered by MCP technologyAsk a question in your existing AI tool: In plain language, query any datapoint included in your Benchmark subscription - from critical mineral prices to BESS cell deployments. Both qualitative and quantitative analysis is accessible.Your AI tool engages the Benchmark Connector: Your assistant fetches the precise data from Benchmark Terminal. One verified answer across teams, with trusted output that removes guesswork.Output backed by transparent methodologies: The generated output is accompanied by the specific Benchmark report it's sourced from, along with the date and methodology.Request Access Not yet subscribed?Get in touch to learn more about Benchmark's mine-to-grid data and analysis. Our team will match you with the right service for your objectives, and integrate our AI Connector from the outset.Contact Us
